title: Thirty-nine years of marriage
summary: Welburn congratulates him on his marriage of nearly 39 years.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: You've been married thirty-nine years coming up, thirty-nine years the 2nd of June. Congratulations. That is an achievement in today's world, seriously... It's not easy, I'm sure, when you're married or being a musician, being an artist, being an artistic person or a person who is in the entertainment field, because you're gone off at odd hours, and if you do go on tour you're away for a while. So I think that's quite an achievement there.
